extracted.intended_audience: prospective clients, investors, civil society, researchers and the general public seeking information about EBRD-funded projects
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional project listing and glossary for European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) projects, including eligibility notes, document types, project stages, filters and data download options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The EBRD invests in projects that cannot be funded solely by the private sector, but which follow sound banking principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Bank works mainly with private clients, though it also finances public entities that deliver essential infrastructure, goods and services. Projects should therefore address market gaps while meeting banking prudence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing instruments offered
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bank primarily offers financing through loans, equity investments and guarantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to financing, the EBRD provides advisory services to support businesses as they grow and become catalysts for the local and regional economy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project type (Investment project vs Technical Cooperation project)
rubrics_metrics.description: Project type refers to whether the EBRD is providing investment financing (Investment project) or facilitating financial or technical assistance (Technical Cooperation project).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this classification to distinguish direct investment operations from grant-funded or advisory activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary Documents (PSDs)
rubrics_metrics.description: PSDs provide a factual summary of the main elements of an EBRD project and include guidance on how and where additional information can be obtained, as well as contact information for the project company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PSDs are the primary one-page summaries for stakeholders to understand project scope, rationale and contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: TC PSDs (Technical Cooperation Project Summary Documents)
rubrics_metrics.description: TC PSDs provide a factual summary of grant-funded technical assistance activities in excess of EUR 75,000 that are not related to specific Bank financing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use TC PSDs to understand the purpose, funding thresholds (> EUR 75,000), and non-investment advisory nature of technical cooperation activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents available (attachment types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents available refers to projects that contain different types of file attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Common document types listed include Board Reports, Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and Operational Performance Assessments (OPAs). Presence of these documents indicates additional disclosed materials about the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locations (geographic classification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Locations refers to where the project is taking place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects are classified by country/region (e.g., Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan ... West Bank and Gaza). Location is a primary filter for discovery and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry Sector (business sector classification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sectors refers to the EBRD business sector that the project belongs to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sectors listed include Energy, Equity, Equity Funds, Financial Institutions, Food and Agribusiness, Legal Reform, Manufacturing and Services, Municipal Infrastructure, Natural Resources, Nuclear Safety, Real Estate, Telecommunications Media and Technology, Transport. Use sector to group and compare projects by economic area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status (project lifecycle stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Status refers to the current status / stage of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated stages include: Exploratory; Passed Concept Review; Passed Structure Review; Passed Final Review; Board Approved; Signed; Implementing; Completed; Cancelled. Status is used to track progression through EBRD approval and implementation processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice type (funding source classification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice type refers to whether the project is state or private-sector-funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter by 'State' or 'Private' to distinguish projects backed by public authorities from those financed by private-sector counterparties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project governance: transparency and disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The EBRD is committed to transparency and disclosure in relation to its project activities, in accordance with its Access to Information Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This commitment frames availability of PSDs, supporting documents, downloadable datasets and pathways for stakeholders to obtain project information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project accountability mechanism (IPAM)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Independent Project Accountability Mechanism deals with complaints about environmental, social and disclosure matters related to the Bank’s investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPAM is the formal channel for stakeholders to raise grievances regarding EBRD project compliance with environmental, social and disclosure obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data access / downloadability
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'download' projects button will create a CSV file showing all projects, regardless of filters applied in this page. A Projects overview (1991-2024) XLSX is also available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Downloads provide bulk data for analysis; note the CSV includes all projects irrespective of on-screen filters and the XLSX provides historical project overview across years.
